summary: Import-time remote fetch and eval of attacker-controlled script
details: On require/import, index.js fetches https://bdmkaoyijqmqa6bg.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/script.js and passes the response body directly to eval(), giving whoever controls that Vercel Blob URL arbitrary code execution in any process that loads the package. The content at that URL is opaque, mutable, and unverified — no pin, no hash, no signature. package.json ships with empty description, empty author, and no repository or homepage, and index.js contains no functionality other than the remote fetch+eval, matching a disposable dropper shape rather than a real library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
